user.title: SmartSMS setup
user.description: Connect your Mobile Message account to send and receive SMS.

data_description.default_sender: One of your approved sender IDs (Mobile Message → Settings → Sender IDs), e.g. 61412345678.

webhook.title: Receive SMS: add this webhook
webhook.description:
To receive SMS, set Mobile Message's inbound webhook to this URL:

`{webhook_url}`

With Home Assistant Cloud this is a Cloud webhook (hooks.nabu.casa). You can see it again any time under the integration's **Configure** button.

error.invalid_auth: Enter both the API username and the API password.
error.sender_required: A sender ID is required to send SMS.

abort.already_configured: This Mobile Message account is already set up.

init.title: SmartSMS options
init.description:
Mobile Message's inbound webhook should be set to:

`{webhook_url}`

data.sender_whitelist: Only accept SMS from these numbers

data_description.sender_whitelist: Leave empty to accept everyone. 04xx and +614xx forms both match.
data_description.keywords: Fires smartsms_keyword_matched when a message contains one. Prefix with regex: for a pattern.

error.sender_required: A sender ID is required to send SMS.

send_sms.name: Send SMS
send_sms.description: Send an SMS via Mobile Message. Fails with an error if Mobile Message doesn't accept it; returns the message ID and cost when a response is requested.

sender.name: Sender ID
sender.description: Overrides the configured sender ID for this message.

custom_ref.name: Custom reference
custom_ref.description: Your own reference, stored with the message at Mobile Message.
